speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are down before I have called. Eat from the soft side. I am not ready for a jaw to be proved at my table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will not prove it. The soft side is the morning's. There is the better part of an hour yet to nine.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is a penny, and it is a full thumb short of the notch. I set it to the mark while the fire took. I cannot bake a healing into it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not asking you to bake it longer. Soft bread and a short loaf can share a board.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will be up the road and back for dinner, and out again after. I can tell a day that means a play. I am not asking which.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not. I will be back when you cut that loaf, and I will go again at two. The house can have the hours between.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is on the third tread. If you go up for the cloak, step over him. He has decided the stair is a bed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will step over him. I am not arguing with a cat before nine.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: See that you do not argue with me either. Sit, and finish, and take the grey cloak. The close is grey enough to match it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The grey cloak, then. I am wanted at the Theatre at nine. I would rather come back with one word settled than with two.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Paper is quieter than a yard. I will keep the broth for when you are back. October puts a want for it into a man, healed or not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it. I will not send it back. And I will not bring the morning down the stair with me when I come in.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Yesterday's words can stay where you left them. Eat. The bell will not wait on you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The bell can have me when I have swallowed this. The soft side is honest. I am not making it into news.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will cut you no crust. If the jaw wants the hard end, it can ask at noon, in front of her, and not in a corner.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: She is right. I will be looking at that jaw at noon, invited or not. This hour is only breakfast.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then this hour is only breakfast. Noon can be noon. I am not spending the proof twice.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: There is small beer if the bread sits heavy. I am not opening the better ale for a man about to walk to Shoreditch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Small beer. I am not a guest in this house. Dinner is the sitting that has a price on it. This is not that sitting.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The penny loaf is the only price on the table now. I will not put another figure beside it before noon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it the only price. Whatever the morning costs, it will not come out of this board.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not bring a cost of yours to my bread. Wipe your mouth. The cloak is on the peg, the cat is on the tread, and the road is yesterday's road.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The same road. I will be out before the hour. I will not invent a reason to be late for paper.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will keep the end of the loaf uncut. If you are brave at noon, the end can say so. If you are not, the broth is still broth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not now, then. Bravery can wait until someone has asked it to chew.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Go up and come down quiet. I know your tread. I do not need a tune on the stair to know you are leaving.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No tune. Over the cat, and out. Keep the fire. I will want the house warm when I am only passing through it.
